newsitem.title: USA: SciClone's Zadaxin gets license in China.
newsitem.headline: SciClone's Zadaxin gets license in China.

text.p: SciClone Pharmaceuticals Inc said it received a license to market its Zadaxin treatment for chronic hepatitis B in China.
The license permits the company to market Zadaxin alone and in combination with the hepatitis drug alpha interferon.

Zadaxin is a synthetic product that stimulates the immune system's disease fighting properties, and causes fewer side effects than other hepatitis drugs. It is also being studied as a treatment for hepatitis C and the AIDS-causing HIV virus.

Last month, SciClone's stock fell sharply after the release of trial results of Xadaxin as a hepitis B treatment, failed to show a statistically significant success rate. But the company said it would continue to seek approval for the drug in several countries in Asia.
